sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact data + prospecting are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Starter, Pro, Custom.

sections.heading: Who Snov.io is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Snov.io when budget SMB email finding plus cold email sequencing with published Starter/Pro rungs is the primary job..

Avoid if: Compare Apollo for broader data+sequences, Hunter for domain-finder simplicity, Reply for deeper multichannel engagement, and Closely for LinkedIn-led outbound..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Apollo.io on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Snov.io price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
